description: One Airtel underground fiber site (node), from PO receipt to handover.

fields.label: Attach PO (PDF)
fields.description: Attach Airtel's PO PDF first: PO number, dates, node ID and PO lines fill in from it.

fields.label: Current Stage
fields.options:
1 - PO Receipt
2 - KMZ and Team
3 - Survey and Feasibility
4 - SLD and Exceptions
5 - CWIP, ROW, Job ID, VLC
6 - Material
7 - Execution
8 - FF1, PP, ATC
9 - Closure and Billing
Completed
Truncated
MO - Billing Only

fields.label: PO Number
fields.description: Full Airtel PO number, e.g. TNL-FF-Maharashtra/PUR/10012674. A revised PO overwrites it; the old one moves to PO History.

fields.label: SAM ID
fields.description: Airtel reference, e.g. SAM2046 (not the Node ID).

fields.label: MO PO Amount
fields.description: Filled from Mobilization PO lines when there are any.

fields.label: KMZ File
fields.description: Attach the KMZ from Airtel: location, tapping point and route length fill themselves.

fields.label: KMZ Proposed Route (m)
fields.description: Length of the proposed route drawn in the KMZ. Used for the length check until the survey length is entered.

fields.label: Site to Tapping Point, straight line (m)
Area Manager
fields.description: Set by the system from the site location (survey, else KMZ) and the area boundaries. You can change it; only Area Managers of the site's area are offered.

fields.label: Area Manager Assignment
fields.description: Pending until the Area Manager approves (In Progress) or rejects; they close it when done. Managed from the Assignments board on the Underground workspace.

fields.label: Survey Planned Date
fields.description: Joint date fixed with the Airtel engineer.

fields.label: Survey Status
fields.options:
Pending
Planned
In Progress
Completed
Hold

fields.label: Survey Length (m)
fields.description: Actual route length.

fields.label: ROW Authorities Identified
fields.description: Each authority becomes its own ROW Application (button: Create ROW Applications).

fields.label: Length Extension Required
fields.description: Ticked by the system when Survey Length (or, before the survey, the KMZ route) > PO civil length.

fields.label: ROW Overall Status
fields.options:
Not Required
Pending
All Received
Rejected

fields.label: Material by Item
fields.description: Received and Dispatched fill in from Material Orders and Dispatches. Enter only the Consumed quantity.

fields.label: Fibre Cable Laid (Cable ID and Meter Readings)
fields.description: One row per cable drum used on the site: the meter marking printed on the cable at the start and at the end of the stretch laid. The length laid becomes the Consumed quantity of that cable.

fields.label: Execution Release Date
fields.description: Allowed only when ROW is all received (or not required), Job ID is mapped, material is dispatched and a team is assigned.

fields.label: Current Execution Stage
fields.options:
T&D
Cable Blowing
Splicing
Testing
FF1
PP
ATC

fields.label: T&D Scope Total (km)
fields.description: Defaults to PO civil length.

fields.label: Depth Deviations
fields.description: One row per stretch where rock or hard strata stops the standard depth.

fields.label: Splicing Vendor
fields.description: The vendor responsible for splicing; their login assigns one of their splicers. Defaults to the Execution Vendor.

fields.label: Splicer
fields.description: Assigned by the splicing vendor (button Splicer → Assign Splicer). The splicer's login then sees this site and can update splicing and OTDR.

fields.label: Splicer Assignment
fields.description: Pending until the splicer approves (In Progress) or rejects; they close it once splicing is completed.

fields.label: PP Closure Status
fields.options:
No PP
Open
Partially Closed
All Closed

fields.label: Billing Ready
fields.description: All PP closed + ATC ready + reconciliation approved + zonal and central approved.

fields.label: Retention Amount
fields.description: Defaults to Retention % of the invoice amount.

name: UG Site
